sample_design: one deterministic, non-nested sample per instance/fraction; reused across both caps and all repeats
warning_rule: execution_error/timeout OR positive nanny termination/spill/paused samples/observed restarts; quality issues yield unknown
quiet_rule: success with complete clean diagnostics, conditions and telemetry, and all declared warning signals zero
selection_rule: per fraction, among configs with three quiet repeats choose lowest median probe lifecycle times balanced target-allocation weight; tie by config id; fallback to high-memory config if none eligible
comparison_unit: instance/target-cap/fraction group; do not pair separate-session repeats or treat repeat rows as independent workloads
stage_gate: Stop after 96 attempts for review; no automatic Stage C, training or main merge
